content: {"episode_id":"ep-05001","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10). The monitoring was medically necessary to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management. The clinical indication documented in the submitted records supports the diagnostic value of this service, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on the basis of medical necessity."}
